text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went up to the rooftop for a breather,
someone was already there—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Alright, not bad for something whipped up on a day off.
Glad I could use that melody I scrapped last time here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That said, where the BPM goes up,
I kinda wanna make it a bit more elaborate—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!?
What the, speak up if you're there...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever. Let me hear your thoughts on it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to have spent a wonderful day off
devoting herself to composing music...!
